The route HTML is public static content on a CDN.

after hydration. Postgres RLS + Edge Functions are the

Data access — no react-query, no SWR
flowType: 'implicit' (no server to exchange a code)

unless signOut() opts in — kills spurious SIGNED_OUT

outside the error boundary — a nav crash is uncaught

email verified? (OAuth bypasses) → E2E keys derived?
PostgREST + RPC over the anon key
row-level policies are the whole authz model
The one API route that survives static export
forces full build-time resolution → emitted as a static JSON file.
no query params possible; anything dynamic must become an Edge Function.
webhooks live in supabase/functions/ for exactly this reason.
sw.js listens for sync tag "sync-offline-queue"; the app registers
SW postMessage SYNC_OFFLINE_QUEUE / THEME_CHANGE have no listeners.

becomes a containing block, un-fixes position:fixed)

every colour annotated with its measured ratio; 7:1
breakpoints xs 20 · sm 26.875 (430 px) · md · lg · xl

gradeSat · gradeContrast · vignette · fov · maxBlur · bricks[]

entirely separate from the DaisyUI --color-* system
R3F / THREEJS DESIGN SYSTEM — dependency direction flows down
Rig.ts 4 camera modes: tour · orbit · follow · walk
raycast hit and R3F silently dropped every click
Hud.tsx owns zero project strings — all typed props
isolation enforced by test: StageCore may not import
driven by baked manifests + an ENU projection
otherwise → Cesium atlas (default); forced to R3F
when a manifest has no atlasBox
CESIUM_BASE_URL assigned inside the dynamic() factory
suppresses slugs that are another site’s embeddedTwin
~8 000 buildings at lidar heights over OSM + 3DEP
CONTENT — everything resolves at build time
plain Markdown + YAML frontmatter (gray-matter) — NOT MDX
id = md5(title + birthtime)[:8] · slug · excerpt (200 ch)
readingTime = ceil(words / 200) · status from draft flag
NOT in prebuild — blog-data.json is a committed 233 KB
artifact; a new post is invisible until someone reruns it
the single content index — read by fs at build, not runtime
generate-rss.js is dead: reads ./blog (absent) and filters on
frontmatter keys no post uses → always an empty feed
two canonical hosts coexist: tortoisewolfe.github.io hardcoded
in sitemap/rss, scripthammer.com hardcoded in DisqusComments
geospatial bake → static artifacts, no database
Microsoft building heights · imagery drape · carve-water
warehouse:* → gltf-transform + meshopt → curated GLB sets
Disqus — third party, no table. Lazy IntersectionObserver.
injects hex-only CSS because embed.js cannot parse oklch
contact → zod schema → Web3Forms, EmailJS on failover
honeypot _gotcha · client rate limit 10/60 s · offline queue
schedule → Calendly | Cal.com iframe behind a consent gate
consent + GA4 + Sentry: client-side only, nothing persisted
read-only data surfaces (no backend of their own)
CI-produced JSON read at build; no uptime service exists
/docs hardcoded DOCS registry → remark at build time
/game Captain, Ship & Crew dice — nothing persisted
/admin every read goes through a SECURITY DEFINER RPC:
conversation lists return metadata only, never ciphertext
user_profiles is_admin IS the source of truth (#240)
auth_audit_logs 16 event types · 90-day cleanup · inet + UA
user_encryption_keys public JWK + Argon2 salt (NULL = legacy)
conversation_members owner|member · soft delete via left_at
SECURITY DEFINER helpers break RLS recursion
public keys are SELECT-open by design
least-privilege dotnet_app role keeps RLS live for .NET
avatars bucket: public read, 5 MB, jpeg/png/webp
path <uid>/<file>; policies use a prefix expression
E2E ENCRYPTION BOUNDARY — the server never holds a key
seed mod P-256 order → keypair via @noble/curves p256
deterministic ⇒ any device decrypts from the same password
ECDH P-256 agreement → AES-GCM-256, fresh 96-bit IV per message
private keys non-extractable CryptoKey in Dexie IndexedDB
MessagingDB v2 migration purged the legacy JWK rows
keys are derived in SignInForm — not in AuthContext
admin messaging views expose metadata only, never ciphertext
Sentry replay is hard-disabled so it can never record this UI
NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_PROVIDER; no base URL → throws, fork-safe
.NET realtime is polling; groups + key rotation stay Supabase-only
STATUS.md is a 2026-05-17 snapshot and its counts (60+ specs, 24 shards, 55/55 RLS) no longer match this tree — no file in the repo states a current total.
Nominal only: @next/bundle-analyzer is a devDependency and the "analyze" script sets ANALYZE=true, but next.config.ts never wraps with it.
Not a package monorepo — one package.json, one deploy. detect-project.js retargets a fork; sites/*.json bake N static twins into the same app.
Drawn from a read of the repository at TortoiseWolfe/ScriptHammer (main). Figures are counted from files, not from documentation.
